to_bmg_cpp: convert a BMGraphBuilder probabilistic program graph into C++ Eigen code for the BMG inference engine
GeneratedGraphCPP_init: initialize a GeneratedGraphCPP instance with a BMGraphBuilder to begin C++ code generation
_value_to_cpp_eigen: convert a PyTorch tensor into C++ Eigen matrix initialization code with row-column transposition
_add_constant: generate C++ code to add typed constant nodes including real, boolean, natural, and matrix types
_generate_node: dispatch and generate C++ code for BMG nodes including observations, queries, factors, distributions, operators, and constants
